causal_evidence: 49 patches start from one accepted ancestor genotype and one lineage_id
each patch has unique individuals while diagnostic region labels are absent from mutation and selection inputs
the field average accepted net resource balance improves from -0.15744 to +0.18194 over eight generations
water preference correlates positively with soil moisture at +0.84993
root depth correlates negatively with soil moisture at -0.59843
shade tolerance correlates negatively with sunlight at -0.44674
wet-vs-dry and shaded-vs-sunlit trait distributions begin identical and diverge over generations
neutral-control uses identical first-generation candidate pools patch-by-patch but does not reproduce the real trait-environment correlations
alternate mutation seed changes exact genomes/hash while preserving the three specialization signals
dispersal remains frozen because migration benefit is not part of P1B
truth_boundary: P1B-S3 proves spatial regional trait distributions under local selection on one heterogeneous fixture. It is not a migration, species, biome, authority, persistence, networking or presentation system.
